question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2146805fed36708fd0cbcba0f6bd4ec195a894ebd29f9f5cc1a3295ee1e0228.png]
solution:
The suitable figure from the given answer figure which will replace the (?) is given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57097d37de48e7946a0000d4c2f3b0afa4221843c9d9da602aeb56c41c3f8c83.png] 

The image is rotating clockwise for 90º to form the next image, and the letter is moving anticlockwise in each step and in place of that letter a new letter is added.

Hence, the correct answer is Option (1).
